entries.zh: 等齐；齐平如一、一律均匀（首字存疑，或为"芋"）
entries.en: even and level, all alike; uniform (headword 'asperar' likely a miswriting of espessar/aparejar)
entries.notes: H 首字带 [疑:芋/等]，M 栏另附 fàn 一读未解，西语 asperar 亦疑有讹；据 M tēng-chēy 与 ygualmente（同样均匀）取"等齐"义。

entries.zh: 待期；候其到来、等待约期
entries.en: to wait watching whether he comes; to await an appointed time

entries.zh: 听便；听候差遣、整装待命（亦可"随宜听便"）
entries.en: to be at one's disposal, to comply as convenient; to stand ready, be prepared (estar aparejado)

entries.zh: 听差；听候吩咐差遣、候人使唤
entries.en: to wait for orders to be given to one; to stand on call
entries.notes: 西语词头尾 "ix." 为未解缩写或按语（不影响主句 esperer a que le manden 之义），释义据 L 主句与 H/M 定。

entries.zh: 候流；宿泊待潮（待水流而后行船）
entries.en: to wait for the current/tide — to lodge awaiting the stream
entries.notes: H"宿"与 M 首音 tǒa（≈"大"）不合，M 或本作"大流"；按西语 esperar la corriente 与"宿"字义取"候流"。

entries.zh: 仰望老爷；指望您（老爷）施恩（"老爷"为马尼拉华侨对西班牙人主上之敬称）
entries.en: I rely on / look to your favor, my lord ("lāu-iā", the honorific Sangleys used for Spaniards); M records the variant bâ-ló-iā
thick (espesso, of food) — glossed "like the food 'aquatt'", an unresolved loanword; source line partly damaged
entries.notes: 西语词头标 [残]，H 带 [疑:稠/绸]，M 附注 "como comida aquatt" 之 aquatt 未解（或系经墨西哥传入之外来食物名，不取实指），故降为 low。

entries.en: hidden, secret (given two readings in M, bat and bit); also dense — M note mixes foreign annotations "condido" (hidden) and "autre" (other)
entries.notes: 括注词头 "(esperar)" 与 H"密"义不合，疑为交叉引用或 "(espessar)" 之讹；M 栏杂外文按语，据其"隐藏"义取"密"。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕如液体之浓稠；湆（濡湿滴沥，字有疑）
entries.en: thick like a liquid thing; 〔source partly damaged, gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: M 栏仅存 gît 一音后即残损，H 带 [疑:湆/淁]，西语 espero 亦疑为 espesso 之讹，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 密藏之物；藏而不露者（西语例"如藏钱"）；H/M 复词字面未解
entries.en: a thick-hidden, concealed thing, "as hidden money"; the H/M compound (sat-ba̍t, var. sat-bi̍t) is literally opaque
entries.notes: H"虱密"与西语释义对应未明（ut moneta＝如钱），据 L 主句 espessa cosa oculta 定"密藏"义。

entries.zh: 稠密；密实（西语尾词 funcion 费解）
entries.en: dense, compact; the trailing word 'funcion' in the Spanish gloss is unclear (perhaps truncated)
entries.notes: H 带 [疑:稠/绸]，西语尾词 funcion 未解，取"稠密"本义。

entries.en: dense growth, thicket, as of a mountain forest; woods

entries.zh: 丛；草木丛聚、树丛（口语、文读两读并录）
entries.en: thicket, clump of growth (given two readings in M: nā and chōng)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕山林；松林／桑林（首字存疑）
entries.en: mountain thicket, forest (pine? or mulberry? — first character doubtful)
entries.notes: M 栏首音节标号 T99 污损难辨，H 首字带 [疑:桑/松]，西语词头尾 "B" 未解，故降为 low。
M 栏标 [残]，按规降为 low；义据 H"深林"与西语 "(espesura.)" 尚明。

entries.zh: 林蒲／林埔；丛草之地、草莽野地（"蒲"或为"埔"）
entries.en: thicket of grasses, herbs; grassy open woodland ground (second character doubtful: reed-plant 蒲 or field 埔; 'capaçe' unclear)
entries.notes: H 第二字带 [疑:蒲/埔]，西语 "o capaçe" 未解，据 M nā-pōu 与西语"草丛"义取"丛草之地"。

entries.zh: 丛集；丛聚、聚集（树木丛生，人群云集）
entries.en: to cluster, to gather thick (of trees or of people)
